prompt: The gallery will remain closed ____ the lighting system has been inspected.
promptZh: 畫廊將繼續關閉，____照明系統完成檢查。

options.whyZh: 此處表達時間終點，而非對比。
until 表示關閉狀態持續到檢查完成。
during 後接名詞，不能接完整子句。
despite 是介系詞，且無轉折語意。

explanationZh: until 表示關閉狀態持續到檢查完成。
evidence: The gallery will remain closed until the lighting system has been inspected.

vocabulary.note: remain closed 表示保持關閉。
